summary: Iteration 148: verified all 5 new features (QR tracking ?ref, social CSV export, hamburger menu glow, personalized flyer via canvas, Publish-on-TikTok) + regressions. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (social/click, admin/social-logs with admin gating, QR+5 locandine assets 200, QR decoded = https://mikilab.de/?ref=flyer). Frontend Playwright: ?ref=flyer fires POST /api/social/click {channel:'flyer'} exactly once per session (second reload does NOT re-fire); menu-attn class present+visible on hamburger in Home/Ricette/Maestro/Impara/Community; flyer lang chips it/de/en/es/fr switch files; bakery-name input generates data:image/png;base64 preview + download href, clearing restores static file; lightbox open/close OK; Publish-on-TikTok downloads flyer, posts {channel:'tiktok'} and opens tiktok.com/upload with zero JS errors; Share falls back to wa.me; admin panel social card shows counters + 7-day chart and CSV button downloads mikilab-social-clicks-2026-08-31.csv with correct day/channel/count rows. Final state restored: social_clicks reset (deleted 3), tiktok_handle='mikilab.de', instagram_url='', facebook_url=''.

issues: The bakery name is drawn at y = H*0.463 which visually collides/overlaps with the last bullet line ('Bread, Pizza & Pastry' / 'Pane, Pizza e Pasticceria') on all 5 flyers. Recommend lowering to ~H*0.478-0.485 (or adding a dark padded band behind the text) so the name sits cleanly in the gap between the bullet list and the QR.
Logged-out Home triggers ~8 x HTTP 401 'Failed to load resource' console errors (authenticated endpoints called before auth state resolves).
React hydration warning in RecipeList: <button data-testid=recipe-fav-*> nested inside <button data-testid=recipe-row-*> (invalid HTML nesting).

action_items: OPTIONAL/POLISH: shift the canvas bakery-name baseline down (~H*0.48) in PromuoviMikiLab.jsx so it no longer overlaps the last bullet line of the flyer.
OPTIONAL: suppress the 401 console noise on logged-out Home by gating authenticated API calls on user presence.
OPTIONAL: fix nested <button> in RecipeList (recipe-fav inside recipe-row) to remove the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: PromuoviMikiLab.jsx canvas effect correctly guards toDataURL with try/catch and same-origin image, no taint risk observed.
GET /api/admin/social-logs correctly projects out _id and enforces require_admin (401 unauthenticated verified).
seed_data_creation: Temporary social_clicks rows (test1/flyer/tiktok) created during testing; all removed via POST /api/admin/social-report/reset. Counters now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-148 features verified end-to-end. rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only real observation is a cosmetic canvas text-placement overlap on the personalized flyer (y factor 0.463 too high).
